mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the monthly CPIAUCSL inflation index above 0.3% over the prior month predicts negative S&P 500 20-day forward returns due to market anticipation of rate hikes.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns remain non-negative when CPIAUCSL crosses 0.3% from below in subsequent months.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly rise in PAYEMS labor cost index above 0.5% coincides with a positive 60-day S&P 500 forward return as firms pass cost increases to consumers via higher equity valuations.
failure_condition: No significant positive return in 60-day window when PAYEMS increases by ≤0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A consecutive monthly decline in GDPC1 personal consumption exceeding 2% signals weakening demand, leading to negative S&P 500 5-day forward returns.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns remain non-negative when GDPC1 declines by ≤2%.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly drop in INDPRO manufacturing index below 100 (from 2017=base) predicts a positive 20-day S&P 500 forward return as lower supply growth supports higher valuations.
failure_condition: No positive 20-day return when INDPRO rises or remains flat.

mechanism_narrative: When FEDFUNDS rises by more than 0.2% over two consecutive months, the S&P 20-day forward return is expected to turn negative as markets price in tighter policy.
failure_condition: 20-day returns are non-negative when FEDFUNDS increases by ≤0.2%.

mechanism_narrative: A sudden drop in UNRATE unemployment below 4.5% triggers a positive 60-day S&P 500 forward return as labor market strength supports equity risk appetite.
failure_condition: No significant positive return over 60 days when UNRATE stays ≥4.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Consecutive monthly declines in RSAFS retail sales of >5% produce a negative 20-day S&P 500 forward return as weak demand erodes market optimism.
failure_condition: 20-day returns are non-negative when RSAFS declines by ≤5%.

mechanism_narrative: Interaction between INDPRO (supply) and HOUST (demand) where INDPRO falls below 100 and HOUST rises above 1100 simultaneously predicts a positive 5-day S&P 500 forward return as market rebalances toward value.
failure_condition: No significant positive 5-day return when INDPRO ≥100 or HOUST ≤1100.
